record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> for the sons<WH01121> of Korah<WH07141>, Maschil<WH04905><WTH8688>.<Fo><Fo> We have heard<WH08085><WTH8804> with our ears<WH0241>, O God<WH0430>, our fathers<WH01> have told<WH05608><WTH8765> us, <FI>what<Fi> work<WH06467> thou didst<WH06466><WTH8804> in their days<WH03117>, in the times<WH03117> of old<WH06924>. <RF>Maschil: or, of instruction<Rf>

<FI> How<Fi> thou didst drive out<WH03423><WTH8689> the heathen<WH01471> with thy hand<WH03027>, and plantedst<WH05193><WTH8799> them; <FI>how<Fi> thou didst afflict<WH07489><WTH8686> the people<WH03816>, and cast them out<WH07971><WTH8762>.

For they got<WH03423><WH00> not the land<WH0776> in possession<WH03423><WTH8804> by their own sword<WH02719>, neither did their own arm<WH02220> save<WH03467><WTH8689> them: but thy right hand<WH03225>, and thine arm<WH02220>, and the light<WH0216> of thy countenance<WH06440>, because thou hadst a favour<WH07521><WTH8804> unto them.
Thou art my King<WH04428>, O God<WH0430>: command<WH06680><WTH8761> deliverances<WH03444> for Jacob<WH03290>.
Through thee will we push down<WH05055><WTH8762> our enemies<WH06862>: through thy name<WH08034> will we tread them under<WH0947><WTH8799> that rise up<WH06965><WTH8801> against us.
For I will not trust<WH0982><WTH8799> in my bow<WH07198>, neither shall my sword<WH02719> save<WH03467><WTH8686> me.
But thou hast saved<WH03467><WTH8689> us from our enemies<WH06862>, and hast put them to shame<WH0954><WTH8689> that hated<WH08130><WTH8764> us.
In God<WH0430> we boast<WH01984><WTH8765> all the day<WH03117> long, and praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thy name<WH08034> for ever<WH05769>. Selah<WH05542>.<CM>
But<WH0637> thou hast cast off<WH02186><WTH8804>, and put us to shame<WH03637><WTH8686>; and goest not forth<WH03318><WTH8799> with our armies<WH06635>.
Thou makest us to turn<WH07725><WTH8686> back<WH0268> from the enemy<WH06862>: and they which hate<WH08130><WTH8764> us spoil<WH08154><WTH8804> for themselves.

Thou hast given<WH05414><WTH8799> us like sheep<WH06629> <FI>appointed<Fi> for meat<WH03978>; and hast scattered<WH02219><WTH8765> us among the heathen<WH01471>. <RF>like...: Heb. as sheep of meat<Rf>
Thou sellest<WH04376><WTH8799> thy people<WH05971> for nought<WH01952>, and dost not increase<WH07235><WTH8765> <FI>thy wealth<Fi> by their price<WH04242>. <RF>for...: Heb. without riches<Rf>
Thou makest<WH07760><WTH8799> us a reproach<WH02781> to our neighbours<WH07934>, a scorn<WH03933> and a derision<WH07047> to them that are round about<WH05439> us.
Thou makest<WH07760><WTH8799> us a byword<WH04912> among the heathen<WH01471>, a shaking<WH04493> of the head<WH07218> among the people<WH03816>.
My confusion<WH03639> <FI>is<Fi> continually<WH03117> before me, and the shame<WH01322> of my face<WH06440> hath covered<WH03680><WTH8765> me,
For the voice<WH06963> of him that reproacheth<WH02778><WTH8764> and blasphemeth<WH01442><WTH8764>; by reason<WH06440> of the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> and avenger<WH05358><WTH8693>.<CM>
All this is come<WH0935><WTH8804> upon us; yet have we not forgotten<WH07911><WTH8804> thee, neither have we dealt falsely<WH08266><WTH8765> in thy covenant<WH01285>.
Our heart<WH03820> is not turned<WH05472><WTH8738> back<WH0268>, neither have our steps<WH0838> declined<WH05186><WTH8799> from thy way<WH0734>; <RF>steps: or, goings<Rf>
Though thou hast sore broken<WH01794><WTH8765> us in the place<WH04725> of dragons<WH08577>, and covered<WH03680><WTH8762> us with the shadow of death<WH06757>.
If we have forgotten<WH07911><WTH8804> the name<WH08034> of our God<WH0430>, or stretched out<WH06566><WTH8799> our hands<WH03709> to a strange<WH02114><WTH8801> god<WH0410>;
Shall not God<WH0430> search this out<WH02713><WTH8799>? for he knoweth<WH03045><WTH8802> the secrets<WH08587> of the heart<WH03820>.
Yea, for thy sake are we killed<WH02026><WTH8795> all the day<WH03117> long; we are counted<WH02803><WTH8738> as sheep<WH06629> for the slaughter<WH02878>.
Awake<WH05782><WTH8798>, why sleepest<WH03462><WTH8799> thou, O Lord<WH0136>? arise<WH06974><WTH8685>, cast <FI>us<Fi> not off<WH02186><WTH8799> for ever<WH05331>.
Wherefore hidest<WH05641><WTH8686> thou thy face<WH06440>, <FI>and<Fi> forgettest<WH07911><WTH8799> our affliction<WH06040> and our oppression<WH03906>?
For our soul<WH05315> is bowed down<WH07743><WTH8804> to the dust<WH06083>: our belly<WH0990> cleaveth<WH01692><WTH8804> unto the earth<WH0776>.
Arise<WH06965><WTH8798> for our help<WH05833>, and redeem<WH06299><WTH8798> us for thy mercies<WH02617>' sake. <RF>for our...: Heb. a help for us<Rf><CM>
